cohort: 150 pregnant women who tested positive for COVID-19 at a tertiary care hospital in Nellore, India, between July 2020 and August 2021
finding: The majority of COVID-19-positive pregnant women were asymptomatic or had mild symptoms, but a significant proportion showed radiographic evidence of pneumonitis; treatment with enoxaparin, antibiotics, and antivirals resulted in low acute care needs, good recovery after birth, and satisfactory discharge condition.
